name: RR Cae
disposition: Known white-dwarf/M-dwarf eclipsing binary. Both approximately 10.6296-day residual trials are about 35 times the established 7.3-hour binary orbit. The folded data visibly contain additional deep eclipses about every 7.3 hours. No new companion is inferred.

literature.title: The mass and radius of the M-dwarf in the short period eclipsing binary RR Caeli
Eclipse timing variations in the WD+dM eclipsing binary RR Cae

limitations: The separate catalogue-listed circumbinary planet is not validated or re-evaluated here. This check only identifies the short binary eclipses contaminating the long-period search. No known TOI transit windows were available to mask for this target.
